# Clone of EAFIT Talent Scholarship

### [Scholarship](https://www.eafit.edu.co/taxonomy/term/1336)

What does the scholarship cover? The total cost of the registration fee and a percentage of the tuition fee.

![postgraduate-pereira-armenia-cali.jpg](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/4a46f5b4-04f4-4690-b459-5fbf5ec49036/web/posgrados-pereira-armenia-cali.jpg)

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/en)
- Clone Of EAFIT Talent Scholarship

### We believe in public service.    We invest in your talent.

At EAFIT we believe in those who, with vocation and a sense of purpose, get up every day to work for the collective well-being and to build the country from the institutional level.

As part of our 65th anniversary celebration, we are launching the Public Talent 65 Years Scholarship for public servants throughout Colombia. This scholarship covers 50% of postgraduate tuition for those seeking a better future for all.

##### Postgraduate programs with public impact

These scholarships apply exclusively to the following specialization and master's degree programs:

## Eligible programs

- [Specializations:](https://www.eafit.edu.co/en/node/51791#4257225834-310106679)
- [Master's degrees:](https://www.eafit.edu.co/en/node/51791#4257225834-2656998673)

[Specializations:](https://www.eafit.edu.co/en/node/51791#4257225834-310106679)

Especializaciones:

1. Specialization in Health Institution Management
2. Specialization in Project Management

[Master's degrees:](https://www.eafit.edu.co/en/node/51791#4257225834-2656998673)

Maestrías:

1. Maestría en Gobierno y Políticas Públicas
2. Maestría en Estudios del Comportamiento
3. Maestría en Economía Aplicada
4. Maestría en Gerencia de Empresas Sociales para la Innovación Social y Desarrollo Local
5. Maestría en Administración de Instituciones de la Salud
6. Master of International Business

#### Who can apply? And what does the scholarship cover?

Application requirements:

To be a public official and have an official document that accredits him as such.

Requirements for granting the award:

To be admitted to one of the participating programs

Benefits of the Scholarship

Previous cardNext card

It covers 50% of the tuition fee for the entire duration of the program.

Applies only to programs defined by the University

Renewable every semester upon meeting academic requirements

It does not cover registration fees, international internships, or other extracurricular costs.

The 50% discount cannot be combined with other EAFIT benefits.

##### How to apply?

Apply using the application form.

Register for your chosen participating program.

Pay the registration fee.

Attach the required documents for program registration.

Schedule your interview.

Await the review of your application.

Await confirmation from the program you applied to.

\*Scholarships are limited and are awarded based on admission and fulfillment of requirements.

###### The application period will   open soon   ! Stay tuned!
